position: A receipt is an index into evidence, never the evidence. The field set below is the whole of it: adding a field is a contract change that has to edit this fixture, which is the point. Minimisation is checked as a closed field set rather than as a byte budget, because a field nobody classified is exactly how a result body arrives inside an audit record.

bounds.why: Truncating a receipt to fit silently drops the evidence references that make it useful; refusing makes an oversized receipt someone's problem at the moment it is produced.
